given: No stock records have been filed
when: The team member opens the home stock table
then: An explicit "No stock at this location" empty state is shown instead of a blank page
architectural_notes: E2E: the zero-records path through the same stack. The repository (app/repositories/) returns an empty result set, the service (app/services/) passes an empty list, the boundary (app/routes/) returns an empty JSON collection (a 2xx, not a 404/error), and the React SPA renders the explicit empty state rather than a blank page. Owner module: stock-service list operation + the client stock-table empty-state branch. Verified against a real branch with no seeded rows; empty is a valid state, never an error.

rationale: Asserts the empty (zero-records) experience, distinct from AC1-AC3 which all seed records; a build could render populated rows correctly yet show a blank page when there is no stock.
